source_evidence: You may cancel your policy within a short period (usually 10 to 30 days) of receiving it without a penalty fee called a surrender charge.
question: What does the free look period allow you to do with a variable life insurance policy?
answer: It allows you to cancel the policy within a short period—usually 10 to 30 days after receiving it—without a surrender charge. You will typically receive a refund of your premiums, though the refund may be adjusted to reflect investment performance.
